digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test environment isolation
propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) copies that expose arbitrary ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments in long tracebacks via saferepr.
A deterministic RED oracle using insertion-ordered synthetic sentinels confirms the credential leakage occurs exactly once per fixture under default long traceback but not under short traceback.

Each of the seven fixtures must be refactored to return an explicit mutable allowlist containing only required variables (fake-bin-first PATH, state directories, and fixture-specific settings) instead of complete environment copies.
The minimal-environment test suite passes with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, proving no behavioral dependency exists on arbitrary inherited ambient variables.
After applying allowlist fixes, the RED oracle must return to GREEN and the exact dict(os.environ) mutation must return the oracle to RED, confirming the fix is complete and precise.
